2511-2586-3197.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat

2366-4247-4452-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
"[Type]" chosen with Rukarumel.
2366-4247-4452-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2728-5231-5662-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-5231-5662-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-5231-5662-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

250-779-1479-5411-7889.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5411-7889.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5411-7889.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

301-4381-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1879-3899-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3918-4131-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that share a creature type.
3918-4131-7013.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's ability by paying {3}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
3918-4131-7013.notes: Once you have extra mana, Basalt Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

4499-6573-7494.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone at least once this game.
4499-6573-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
4499-6573-7494.notes: You must have cast a commander from the command zone at least twice this game for this combo to add infinite mana.

2577-6797-7390.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1636-3967-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Intruder Alarm triggers three times. Resolve the Intruder Alarm triggers from this step and step 2, untapping all creatures four times.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Belonging.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

338-4050-4772-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-4050-4772-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

4050-4681-5170-6094.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1116-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3470-4094-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3470-4094-5702-6973.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 4.

2232-3821-5147-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-3821-5147-6843.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

224-573-1772-6763.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

11-1367-5131-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-1367-5131-6276.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Nexus of Fate.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Nexus of Fate, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-1367-5131-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2438-2736-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2438-2736-5434-5555.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-3480-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-3480-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.

428-2736-3908-5096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-2736-3908-5096.description:
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted by paying {R}{W}{U}, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Spark Double triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

618-1872-2178.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When the Composite Golem token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1722-2425-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1722-2425-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {1}.
Smothering Abomination's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

297-4969.notablePrerequisites:
Belt of Giant Strength attached to your commander.
Your commander does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
297-4969.description:
Declare your commander as an attacker.
Rafiq's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Rafiq trigger, giving your commander +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second Rafiq trigger, giving your commander double strike until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using your commander, causing at least twenty-two damage to be dealt.
The opponent loses the game due to being dealt twenty-one or more damage by your commander.

1636-4013.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap for at least enough mana to activate your blink effect.
1636-4013.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to activate Eldrazi Displacer.
Pay the mana cost to activate Eldrazi Displacer, blinking another creature you control.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-4013.notes: If your creatures generate more mana than is necessary for the loop, this results in infinite mana.

2011-4804-5168.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
You control a blue and a black permanent.
2011-4804-5168.description:
Declare Najeela and Beacon Hawk as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Najeela and Beacon Hawk.
Beacon Hawk triggers, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat each combat phase.

2060-4050-4772-5105.manaNeeded: {4} in at least three different colors
2060-4050-4772-5105.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler giving it six +1/+1 counters because of Doubling Season.
Remove all six counters getting {W} {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Sacrifice Crawler to Altar for one mana of any color.
Pay Sigil's cost of {1}{W} returning Crawler to hand.
Recast Crystalline Crawler for all but one of the remaining floating mana giving it eight +1/+1 counters.
Remove all eight counters netting {8} of assorted colors containing at least {W} {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Repeat steps 4-7.
